text:
omar_partnerships: Quick sync — Partner (BrightLayer) asked if we can surface embeddings from their on-prem data without sending raw docs to our hosted model. They want a hybrid: local preproc -> hosted embed. Any blockers?
maria_sre: technically fine but need to confirm telemetry + egress billing. if embeddings requests originate from partner infra to our hosted API, logs show IPs and payload sizes. we should flag in contract.
liam_sales: Pricing question from their buying team: do we charge per-embedding call or per-token since they’ll pre-chunk? They also asked about a licensing option for a dedicated model instance.
jess_eng: @liam_sales short answer: embeddings billed per request unit (per vector) for hosted. dedicated instance would be quoted as reserved capacity. For pre-chunking we can recommend batch endpoints to reduce unit cost.
omar_partnerships: partner also worried about rate limits — their connector will burst during reindex. Can we offer a ramp plan or temporary higher throughput?
maria_sre: we can carve a time-limited quota bump on Dedicated or a scheduled throttle policy on Hosted. ops-bot: quota_change_request accepted: grant_temp_burst=2000rps window=2h requestor=omar_partnerships
liam_sales: Great — include that in the statement of work. Also legal flagged model-weight licensing: they want to run quantized weights on-prem later. Is that allowed with our standard partner agreement?
jess_eng: Model licensing is model-dependent. For our Redwood-verified open models we can provide exportable weights under the model's OSS license; for proprietary vendor models, no. I'll pull the model list and mark which can be exported.
omar_partnerships: Security questionnaire: they asked about data retention for embedding vectors and whether vectors are reversible. Need a quick blurb we can paste into their Sec Questionnaire.
maria_sre: Blurb: "Embedding vectors are non-reversible with current public methods; we retain vectors for 30 days by default for telemetry and caching. Customers can request deletion or enable no-retention mode. All vectors in transit are TLS1.3 and at-rest encryption uses customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private."
liam_sales: Can you turn that into a 2-sentence line for the Q? simple: "Vectors are non-reversible; retention default 30 days, deletions on request; Dedicated/Private support CMK."
jess_eng: Also add a note about PII: recommend partner run a PII scrub before sending, we can offer a small preproc snippet. Example:```python
# simple PII scrub example
def scrub(text):
    # placeholder, use partner's PII tool in prod
    return re.sub(r"\b\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}\b", "<CC>", text)
```
omar_partnerships: OK — next ops: they want telemetry export to their Splunk. Is there an endpoint we can point to?
maria_sre: yes we can set up a telemetry webhook or S3 export. recommend S3 bucket + cross-account role for larger volumes. Splunk -> we can stream via our connector.
liam_sales: Action items for docs + SOW: 1) Temporary burst quota 2) Pricing note for embeddings vs reserved capacity 3) Licensing matrix for exportable models 4) Security blurb for questionnaire 5) Telemetry export option + egress estimate.
jess_eng: I'll draft the licensing matrix and small PII preproc snippet. maria_sre can you draft the security blurb into Q-format? omar, I’ll ping you when drafts are ready.
maria_sre: will do, adding egress estimate: ~0.8GB per 10k vectors transferred; include that in SOW so their infra knows bandwidth costs.
omar_partnerships: thanks all. Quick ask — can we provision a staging token with higher qps for their engineering trial tomorrow morning (PST)?
ops-bot: token_provisioned id=stg-brightlayer-01 qps=500 expires=3429890000
liam_sales: Perfect. I'll update the proposal and send to BrightLayer legal after we get jess' matrix and maria's Q answers. :thumbsup:
omar_partnerships: Closing — will follow up with a short checklist later. Thanks!
